description: Test file for httplog package, containing unit tests for logging, response writer wrapping, and request handling in the Kubernetes API server.

methods.name: TestDefaultStacktracePred
methods.description: Tests the default stack trace predicate for various HTTP status codes.

methods.name: TestStatusIsNot
methods.description: Tests the StatusIsNot function with different status code slices.

methods.name: TestWithLogging
methods.description: Tests the withLogging middleware and its panic behavior.

methods.name: TestLogOf
methods.description: Verifies the type of logger returned by LogOf based on request logging state.

methods.name: TestUnlogged
methods.description: Tests the Unlogged function and the effect of WithLogging middleware.

methods.name: TestLoggedStatus
methods.description: Checks that the logged response writer correctly updates status after Write and WriteHeader.

methods.name: TestRespLoggerWithDecoratedResponseWriter
methods.description: Tests the response writer with different fake implementations and hijacking capabilities.

methods.name: TestResponseWriterDecorator
methods.description: Ensures the respLogger decorator correctly unwraps the inner ResponseWriter.
